reviews.text: Thank you so much for the 5 stars Blake! We're so glad you and your pet had a great visit at BLVD Vet Logan Square. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!
BLVD always takes great care of our dog and does a great job of answering all of our questions. Our dog actually loves going to BLVD!

I've been taking both my dog and cat here for a year now. I decided to change vets both because they are around the corner from me, and I wasn't very happy with the 7 years I was going to VCA Ark, alas.

I've been nothing but impressed with both the facilities and the staff at BLVD Vet in Logan Square. I'm always able to get in quickly if something weird is going on with my crew, and everyone is so nice and understanding. The care my crew gets here is phenomenal, and I always leave feeling like I wholly understand what to do next and never rushed.

They have treats for the animals, and a cooler full of beverages for the parents. All of this for the same price as VCA, just saying...I figured it was going to be wildly expensive for how nice it is. It's the same. FYI. If I was wondering, I bet you are too.

Anywhoo, really grateful to have them in my neighborhood.

XOX,
Saira, Momo, and Lore

The best vet experience we've had since moving home to Chicago from LA in 2020. We started at the Ravenswood location and then moved over to the Logan Square location. Been bringing our 2 dogs here for a couple years now and so pleased with everything about this spot!

Previously tried another vet in Lincoln Park, but they were not compatible with our anxious german shepherd mix. Once we found BLVD, we were golden. Everyone on staff is so caring, gentle, and patient. They take the extra 5 minutes making sure your dog is comfortable and relaxed before starting the exam. This made all the difference with our anxious pup and we were finally able to have a successful vet visit, after multiple failed attempts over the years.

Can't thank them enough. They sincerely love animals and it's evident in the way they approach and treat each animal. Can't imagine ever going to another vet.

Hello S R, 
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review.  We appreciate your feedback and would love to hear more about your experience and if there was anything we can do to improve.  Please feel free to reach out to us at logansquare@blvd.vet.  
Have a great day, 
Megan 
BLVD Logan Square Practice Manager

This is a wonderful vets office!! Our new dog can be reactive towards other dogs and they settled us in a room right away so she wouldn’t see anyone else. They were so kind, helpful, informative, and detailed. I feel so confident having them so close by!

been taking my cat to this and the Ravenswood cat location and I cannot scream their praise enough! my kitty is both medically complex and absolutely terrified of the vet, so having Blvd’s support, referrals, tests, and gentle care for him during our numerous visits has been so amazing. every doctor who has seen my cat has been knowledgeable and throughly explains everything, answering all the anxious questions I may have. I highly recommend this place!
Caring, thorough and convenient. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone!
Cannot believe I just paid $160 for a rabies shot and not one person had the courage to say the price up front before

Sasha (my dog) and I recently visited Boulevard Veterinary Logan Square. Staff is very friendly and was gentle with Sasha. The facility is clean and the visitor center is comfortable. The medical staff was prompt and the appointment was underway right on time. Left fully informed, had my questions answered, felt in a good place to make decisions going forward. 5 Stars.
They took wonderful care of my senior kitty, who needed a specialized kidney & gut diet. Highly recommend for senior animals. Thank you!!!

I just had my first visit with BLVD Vet, and specifally Dr. Brill. My dog Callie is quite nervous at vets, but Dr Brill and her team went above and beyond to make sure Callie and I were comfortable during the entire exam. They treated her so calmly, made sure every step was taken slowly to avoid her nervousness, and were able to complete everything Callie needed with no issues at all.

I would highly recommend this vet to any owners with reactive dogs - this team knows what they are doing!

Thank you for the positive rating Donna! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon. 🐾

Have a great day,
Megan
Logan Square Practice Manager

We appreciate your positive feedback and are grateful you chose BLVD for your pet’s care. It means a lot to our team, and we’re always here when you need us. 🐾

Have a great day,
Megan
Logan Square Practice Manager

We’ve been taking our dog to BLVD for over a year and never want to go anywhere else. The whole team is so thoughtful, warm, and professional. When we were looking for a vet, it was really important to us to find somewhere owned and operated by real people who care about animals and about the community—not some private equity shell. BLVD is not only local and independent, they treat your pets like their own. They take such good care of our dog and always make us feel heard and reassured. Every vet, tech, and staff member we’ve interacted with has been wonderful. Our dog loves going to her appointments so much she drags us through the door. Thank you BLVD! 💛

Thank you for the 5-star rating Sarah! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you had a great experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you again soon. 🐾

Have a great day,
Megan
Logan Square Practice Manager

I've been brining my dog Mowgli here for the past two months since we rescued him as a stray in January. I appreciate all the help they've been through his positive heartworm diagnosis. All of the staff and the doctors have been so kind and welcoming to us, and I can tell they really are so invested in helping Mowgli. I also feel like the prices have been generally reasonable/standard, especially for the heartworm injections. He did great at his first treatment and the vet techs that took care of him told me that he was super affectionate and did a great job, which really put me to ease.

First time visit, loved it! Update: Have been taking our dog there for 7 years now and I still am so happy with them. They are always there to answer our questions and concerns! Recommend them to everyone.
My vets who take care of Berlin Vom Princehaus

I have 4 pets and I bring them all to BLVD Vet. Every vet we’ve worked with has been great, very understanding and did their best to work with us. Explained everything thoroughly so that we felt comfortable and like our pets are in good hands. Nothing but a great experience here!

I started coming here 2 years ago after adopting a puppy who had giardia. My initial experience was with the receptionist who thoughtfully listened to my concerns, consulted with the doctor and gave me solutions.  This was before I made an appointment.  I was so thankful and impressed with her kind professionalism.  I continue to be impressed and moved by this incredible staff.

They are kind,  efficient,  knowledgeable and really, truly love animals.  They evaluate your pets needs and don't push unnecessary tests or medications to pad your bill.  (I have had that unfortunate experience with another establishment). They are what healthcare providers of all kinds should strive to be.

Our cats have been going to BLVD for almost three years now, and I cannot recommend them enough. BLVD is hands down the best place to take your pets for veterinary care! They are incredibly attentive, gentle, and patient with both care taker and pet. Everyone at BLVD is fantastic, but Dr. Brill has always gone above and beyond for the care of our chronic illness kitty. I never feel like our concerns are dismissed or minimized, and I know that each visit will end with all of my questions answered. We are forever grateful for the care that BLVD gives us!
Love the office space and the staff is friendly and patient!
Facility is very clean, staff is so friendly and helpful, always get care quickly and all prices are discussed up front. Very happy with our experience :)
Our puppy, Travis, always has a nice time at the vet!  I think it might be one of his favorite places!

I highly recommend BLVD! Everyone was kind, those behind the desk answering phones and checking in, the vet techs, and the vet! My scaredy cat was comfortable and each person who handled him made sure to do so calmly and with care. Transparent pricing and services as well. This will be our new home for checkups!

Most vet offices are run by private equity and you can tell. BLVD is completely different. They treat your pet as if it were their own. The doctors and technicians are so helpful and thoughtful.

They sat with me and discussed my cat’s health issue at length, before recommending AGAINST moving forward with expensive diagnostics. It was the right move and my cat is now feeling better. I have peace of mind knowing that I didn’t overpay for unnecessary work and that my cat’s health is cared for. Thank you, BLVD!

We always have a great experience at BLVD Vet Logan Square, from easy scheduling to comfortable and safe visits with our scared, reactive dog. The vet tech we recently had was exceptional and our hesitant dog loved her almost right away. We have seen many vets here over the last few years and all of them have been welcoming, accessible, knowledgeable, and patient with all our questions and discussions. We are so grateful to have a place nearby to take our beloved boy.

The front desk staff is aggressive, uncaring and antagonistic. The vet visits feel like a grift or a shell game leveraging your fear of your pets health to extort extra money. Life and death decisions are met with cold indifference and questioning the bill gets you a lecture from the abysmal front desk manager and her faithful lieutenant.
Please don’t take your loved ones here.
There’s so many more options in Chicago and it’s widely known they have a horrific client facing staff.
Blvd are the best, they go above and beyond to make trips here as enjoyable as possible for all

I have been a client of BLVD Logan Square for several years now with two senior dogs with complications and everyone that I've interacted with over the years has been kind and professional. They took great care of my advanced kidney disease elderly dog and were able to do a dental with extractions so that she lived her last couple of years in comfort. Our current nearly 15 year old dog has heart disease and I'm very confident in BLVD's ability to help us manage it.
I also appreciate their very clear estimates and billing invoices, everything is always straightforward.

Convenience but most importantly the exam room is always ready right when I arrive with my cat so she never has the added stress of a waiting room with other animals. She doesn't love the vet, but it's as stress free as possible for her.

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating Kim! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful for the trust you place in our team. It means a lot to us, and we look forward to taking great care of you and your pet again soon. 🐾

Sincerely,
Megan
BLVD Logan Square Practice Manager

I love BLVD and am so happy to be apart of the Logan community with them. Everyone here is so nice and knowledgeable about all things pets. You can tell they all care so much about the pets they treat. I feel like my baby is in safe hands whenever I come here. Can’t recommend them enough 🐈 ❤️ …

I have nothing but glowing things to say about BLVD-Logan Square. Taking my very nervous girl in as a new cat mom could've been a disasterous experience, but the team at BLVD made it so easy and took great care of her. Thanks again!

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating Maria!
 
We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. It means a lot to us, and we look forward to caring for you and your pet again in the future.

Sincerely,
Megan
BLVD Logan Square Practice Manager
Very attentive and flexible while working with my anxious dog. Scheduling was easy and they were able to work with me to find the most convenient appointment.

Everyone at BLVD Vet Logan Square has taken amazing care of our three cats, who are all at varying life stages (4 to 17 years old). We feel like all the practitioners really care about our cats, and take the time to really listen to our concerns and questions about our different cats’ needs.

I truly cannot say enough good things about BLVD Logan Square. Taking my baby to the vet has never been easy, but this team goes above and beyond to make sure Ash feels as safe, calm, and loved as possible. They know how hard the lobby can be for her, and every single time they make sure a room is ready right when we walk in so she can avoid stressful interactions. That alone means more to me than I can put into words.
Dr. Brill is an absolute angel. She has such a warm, gentle presence, and my baby feels it immediately. From the very beginning, she showed so much patience, taking the time to truly understand Ash, her personality, and even her moodiness (lol). This past year, Ash has been through so much, and we found ourselves at the clinic often. During every visit, Dr. Brill was incredibly thorough, compassionate, and reassuring, making sure we understood everything and never making us feel rushed or overwhelmed.
Every visit reminds me how lucky we are to have found this clinic. Thank you to Dr. Brill and the entire BLVD Logan Square team for treating our babies like your own. Your love, passion, and compassion shine through in everything you do, and we are endlessly grateful.

My cat died 2 years ago from renal cancer. You would know that if you ever bothered to follow up after the multiple visits we made in her final months.Your team never found the cancer that killed her, you just kept scheduling her for more tests while she got weaker by the day. I took her to your pets wellness and they found cancer in her in less than an hour. Today is not even her birthday, but it definitely ruined my day getting this email.
